acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Elna Baker tells Ira about two detectives who solved a murder remarkably quickly, especially considering that they were still in middle school.
acts.credits: By Elna Baker and Ira Glass

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Lilly Sullivan tells the story of an elementary school “movie day” that went horribly wrong for many of the kids.
acts.title: Magically Malicious

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Chris Benderev speaks with writer Georgie Codd, who went searching for someone to be the father she never had.
acts.title: Classified Dad

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Michelle Navarro attended a Catholic youth group retreat when she was thirteen. She didn’t expect the older kids to use the recruitment tactics they used, with the help of adult accomplices.
acts.title: Stations of the Double Cross
